text: Guide derivation landed: GuidePolicy (NoGuides/Explicit/Derived) on PlotCompilerOptions; Derived produces x/y axes from trained scales (transform-aware ticks: log10 breaks in raw domain positioned in mapped unit space) and legends from discrete color/fill scale palettes; explicit overrides suppress matching derived guides; panel ranges derive from position scales (unit interval) or resolved rows via options.frame, so DesignGraphics no longer hand-trains Interval ranges. TrainedScale now carries the live scale; GuideSpec.Axis supports explicit ticks. GuideDerivationSuite 6 cases; 79/79 JVM+JS, design green.
